text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. The eager anticipation throughout the venue
is reaching all the way to the waiting room~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The anticipation builds with every passing second...!
The moment she steps out, the cheers will erupt...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aww, it feels like
I'm stepping onto a disco dance platform♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! If I had a folding
fan right now, I'd want to wave it all over the place!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is looking forward to it, after all!
I have to show them what I've got!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm gonna go blast right through!
